platform_claims_checked.claim: An agent is an LLM that runs in a loop, calling tools to take action. Each iteration the LLM receives context (system prompt, conversation, tool results), decides on the next step, and either responds to you or calls a tool.
The agent harness is the surrounding code that runs the loop. It exposes tool definitions to the LLM, executes the tool calls, and feeds results back in.
Claude Code is one harness; Cursor, Cline, Gemini CLI are others.
MCP-connector tools land in the same [tool] set as natively-available tools.
